modules.intended_role: canonical sparse Euclidean Clifford algebra Cl(n,0) kernel for exact representation and ablation experiments
known_gaps: mathematical algebra correctness does not establish climate relevance
current kernel is Euclidean signature only
oscillation-coupling value must be tested against complex, spectral, Hilbert-phase, bispectral, and DMD/Koopman baselines

modules.intended_role: canonical typed ice-albedo observation, finite-difference estimation, numerical-degeneracy, and policy-separation primitives
known_gaps: finite-difference estimator currently uses only adjacent albedo/temperature samples
ice extent is retained as context but not yet used by the estimator
340 W/m2 mapping and policy thresholds preserve legacy assumptions and are not empirically validated

modules.intended_role: canonical CPU Levi-Civita geometry kernel from explicit local metric jets for Christoffel, Riemann, Ricci, scalar-curvature, and accelerator differential verification
known_gaps: does not define or validate a climate metric
local metric derivatives are caller-supplied and require independent AD/finite-difference witnesses
correct geometric tensors do not justify curvature-to-tipping probability or timescale interpretations
GPU equivalence remains unverified

modules.intended_role: canonical rank-revealing expected Fisher information for local Gaussian mean models from explicit mean Jacobians and observation-noise scales
known_gaps: caller must supply an independently trustworthy mean-model Jacobian
current kernel assumes independent Gaussian observation errors with parameter-independent standard deviations
Amari alpha-connections remain reference-only rather than implemented in this numerical layer
no climate parameter-estimation model has yet been wired through this kernel

modules.intended_role: canonical finite Kripke-frame semantics for compositional scenario necessity/possibility specifications
known_gaps: does not define which climate propositions are scientifically valid
does not infer accessibility from physical feasibility scores or probabilities
empirical usefulness of modal scenario specifications remains untested

modules.intended_role: canonical numerical verification primitives with measured conditioning separated from acceptance policy
known_gaps: currently covers SVD-based conditioning only
callers must migrate from legacy guardrail implementations before legacy conditioning code can be retired

modules.intended_role: canonical exact finite-precision p-adic residue-class and ultrametric primitives for falsifiable representation experiments
known_gaps: mathematical correctness does not justify any climate-to-p-adic encoding
comparisons across distinct prime bases or precisions are intentionally undefined rather than heuristically fabricated
empirical teleconnection value remains untested against generic ultrametric, hierarchical, graph, spectral, and learned baselines

modules.intended_role: canonical real-valued finite cellular-sheaf operators for explicit restrictions, compatibility residuals, degree-zero sheaf Laplacians, and SVD-derived structural diagnostics
known_gaps: current canonical operator is degree-zero on finite graphs rather than higher-dimensional cellular complexes
scientifically defensible climate stalks, restrictions, and station-cover construction remain open
spectral/nullity diagnostics have no empirical climate interpretation without preregistered benchmarks
sparse and GPU implementations remain future differential-verified accelerations

modules.intended_role: production-oriented CPU adapter around LAPACK DGTTRF/DGTTRS for reusable partial-pivoting tridiagonal solves with explicit residual and pivoting diagnostics
known_gaps: LAPACK success is not a task-specific conditioning or scientific acceptance policy
current wrapper covers one right-hand side per solve call even though factorization is reusable
GPU and distributed backends remain separate implementation identities requiring differential verification
operator construction, units, and physical meaning remain caller-owned

modules.intended_role: transparent no-pivot tridiagonal reference factorization, residual diagnostics, and theta-method oracle for differential verification of production solver backends
known_gaps: Thomas factorization intentionally cannot solve systems requiring row pivoting and must not be treated as the production linear backend
operator coefficients, boundary conditions, units, and physical interpretation remain caller-owned contracts
pivot tolerances are explicit numerical-policy inputs and require task-specific justification
theta stepping is a reference primitive rather than the final integrator architecture; SUNDIALS ARKODE is the preferred production integration trajectory
manufactured linear witnesses do not validate climate timestep selection or coupled physics

modules.intended_role: canonical portable reference primitives for deterministic DFT, analytic signals, phase unwrapping, and instantaneous frequency
known_gaps: direct DFT is intentionally reference-speed rather than production FFT
broader CWT, SSA, multitaper, and coherence methods remain to be migrated with dedicated witnesses
not yet compared against an independent external numerical implementation

modules.intended_role: transparent deterministic classical RK4 reference primitive for explicit ODE state vectors with fail-closed tendency-callback and non-finite-state handling
known_gaps: fixed-step RK4 is retained as a differential/reference oracle rather than the intended production climate integrator
production adaptive, IMEX, and multirate integration should prefer maintained solver libraries such as SUNDIALS ARKODE
tendency correctness and physical units remain caller-owned contracts
manufactured ODE witnesses establish numerical behavior but do not validate climate time stepping or physics coupling
